title: A Framework for Generating Artificial Datasets to Validate Absolute and Relative Position Concepts

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) using synthetic datasets (Scrapbook) where objects are placed in controlled, arbitrary absolute and relative positions to test if the models rely on typical spatial locations rather than true concept understanding.

Testing object recognition capabilities by extracting objects from their natural environments and overlaying them onto diverse or plain background images to ensure models do not rely on environmental cues or background associations.
